access_deprivation.label: Mynediad at wasanaethau (SIMD, NIMDM)
access_deprivation.description: Parth mynediad daearyddol Mynegai Amddifadedd Lluosog yr Alban 2020 (amseroedd gyrru a thrafnidiaeth gyhoeddus i feddygon teulu, ysgolion, siopau, swyddfeydd post a gorsafoedd petrol), wedi'i ddwyn i barthau data 2022.

noise_exposure.label: Cartrefi mewn sŵn trafnidiaeth neu ddiwydiant

aircraft_noise.label: Cartrefi mewn sŵn awyrennau

industrial_noise.label: Cartrefi mewn sŵn diwydiannol

night_noise.label: Cartrefi mewn sŵn yn y nos

rail_service.label: Gwasanaeth rheilffordd gerllaw

hospital_ae_distance.label: Pellter i'r adran achosion brys agosaf

crime_violence.label: Troseddau treisgar a rhywiol

crime_damage_disorder.label: Difrod troseddol a threfn gyhoeddus

road_danger.label: Gwrthdrawiadau ffordd difrifol gerllaw

iod_crime.label: Parth troseddu'r mynegai amddifadedd

wind_speed.description: Cyflymder cyfartalog y gwynt ar 10m, cyfartaledd 1991–2020.

future_hot_days.label: Diwrnodau poeth o haf mewn byd 2°C yn gynhesach
future_hot_days.description: Diwrnodau y flwyddyn â thymheredd uchaf dros 30°C unwaith y bydd y byd wedi cynhesu 2°C, o ragamcanion lleol UKCP18 y Swyddfa Dywydd.

domestic_rates.label: Ardrethi domestig (cartref nodweddiadol)
domestic_rates.description: Bil ardrethi domestig blynyddol cartref ar werth cyfalaf canolrifol yr ardal, o'r gyfradd ranbarthol a chyfradd ardal y cyngor (Gogledd Iwerddon).

snow_days.label: Diwrnodau ag eira ar lawr
snow_days.description: Diwrnodau y flwyddyn ag eira ar lawr am 9am, cyfartaledd 1991–2020.

council_tax_typical.label: Treth gyngor (cartref nodweddiadol yma)
council_tax_typical.description: Yr hyn mae cartref nodweddiadol yn yr ardal yn ei dalu mewn treth gyngor, tâl pob band wedi'i bwysoli yn ôl faint o gartrefi'r ardal sydd yn y band hwnnw.

gp_list_size.label: Cleifion fesul practis meddyg teulu gerllaw
gp_list_size.description: Cleifion cofrestredig fesul practis yn y practisau meddyg teulu ger cartrefi, wedi'u pwysoli yn ôl pellter.

allotment_distance.label: Pellter i'r rhandiroedd agosaf
allotment_distance.description: Pellter cyfartalog mewn llinell syth o gartrefi i'r rhandiroedd neu'r man tyfu cymunedol agosaf.

radon_potential.label: Cartrefi mewn ardal radon uchel
radon_potential.description: Cyfran y cartrefi mewn sgwariau grid lle disgwylir i fwy na 10% o gartrefi fod uwchlaw lefel weithredu radon (atlas dangosol BGS ac UKHSA; map radon yr EPA yn Iwerddon).

ev_charging.label: Pwyntiau gwefru cyhoeddus gerllaw
ev_charging.description: Safleoedd gwefru cerbydau trydan cyhoeddus o fewn 1.5km i gartrefi, ar gyfartaledd (OpenStreetMap, ESB ar ynys Iwerddon, Open Charge Map).

listed_buildings.label: Adeiladau rhestredig gerllaw
listed_buildings.description: Adeiladau rhestredig o fewn 1km i gartrefi, fesul km² (Historic England, Cadw, Historic Environment Scotland a'r Adran Gymunedau; yn Iwerddon, y Rhestr Genedlaethol o Dreftadaeth Bensaernïol ar raddfa ranbarthol neu uwch).

safety.label: Sábháilteacht
safety.description: Coireacht agus iompar frithshóisialta a taifeadadh san áit a bhfuil cónaí ar dhaoine.

environment.label: Timpeallacht
environment.description: Aer glan, sráideanna ciúine, crainn agus spásanna glasa in aice láimhe, agus riosca tuilte.

health.label: Seirbhísí sláinte
health.description: Cé chomh héasca is atá sé do chónaitheoirí dochtúir teaghlaigh, cógaiseoir nó fiaclóir a fheiceáil.

education.label: Scoileanna agus cúram leanaí
education.description: Scoileanna agus naíonraí maithe faoi rochtain.

transport.label: Iompar agus nascacht
transport.description: Cé chomh maith is a nascann ceantar le poist agus le seirbhísí ar gach modh, agus a leathanbhanda.

amenities.label: Áiseanna agus saol na hoíche
amenities.description: Siopaí, caiféanna, tithe tábhairne dea-reáchtáilte, fóillíocht agus cultúr in aice láimhe.

housing.label: Tithíocht agus inacmhainneacht
housing.description: An méid a chosnaíonn tithe agus bail an stoic tithíochta.

community.label: Pobal agus folláine
community.description: Ioncam, obair agus sláinte na ndaoine a chónaíonn ann.

climate.label: Aeráid
climate.description: Grian, báisteach agus cé chomh te is atá an samhradh agus cé chomh séimh is atá an geimhreadh, ó mheáin tríocha bliain.

family.label: Teaghlach le leanaí
family.description: Scoileanna agus naíonraí maithe, sábháilteacht agus spásanna glasa ar dtús.

young_professional.label: Gairmí óg
young_professional.description: Naisc, rudaí le déanamh agus tithe tábhairne maithe; is lú tábhacht na scoileanna.

retiree.label: Ar scor
retiree.description: Sábháilteacht, seirbhísí sláinte, aer glan, grian agus ceantar níos ciúine.

commuter.label: Comaitéir
commuter.description: Naisc thapa le poist, ar iompar poiblí thar aon rud eile.

units.patients_per_gp: othair in aghaidh an dochtúra teaghlaigh lánaimseartha

flags.imputed: Is meastacháin iad na figiúirí coireachta anseo: ní fhoilsíonn Póilíní Greater Manchester sonraí ar leibhéal sráide.
flags.low_n: Is beag teach a díoladh anseo le bliain anuas, mar sin tá an praghas cobhsaithe i dtreo an cheantair máguaird.
flags.broadcast_lad: Tagann cáilíocht na meánscoileanna ó thorthaí scrúduithe na comhairle ar fad, mar ní fhoilsíonn an náisiún seo torthaí ná gráid chigireachta in aghaidh na scoile.
flags.not_available: Níl roinnt táscairí ar fáil sa náisiún seo go fóill; úsáideann an téama na cinn atá aige.
flags.theme_gap: Tá ró-bheagán sonraí oscailte ag an náisiún seo chun téama amháin a scóráil: taispeántar é mar shonraí teoranta agus fágtar as an iomlán é.

crime_violence.label: Cionta foréigneacha agus gnéasacha
crime_violence.description: Foréigean agus cionta gnéasacha a taifeadadh in aghaidh 1,000 cónaitheoir sa bhliain (meán 36 mí).

crime_burglary.label: Buirgléireacht
crime_burglary.description: Buirgléireachtaí a taifeadadh in aghaidh 1,000 cónaitheoir sa bhliain.

crime_asb.label: Iompar frithshóisialta
crime_asb.description: Eachtraí iompair fhrithshóisialta a tuairiscíodh in aghaidh 1,000 cónaitheoir sa bhliain.

crime_theft.label: Robáil, gadaíocht agus coireacht feithiclí
crime_theft.description: Robáil, gadaíocht ón duine, coireacht feithiclí agus gadaíocht rothar in aghaidh 1,000 cónaitheoir sa bhliain.

crime_damage_disorder.label: Damáiste coiriúil agus ord poiblí
crime_damage_disorder.description: Damáiste coiriúil, coirloscadh agus cionta oird phoiblí in aghaidh 1,000 cónaitheoir sa bhliain.

road_danger.label: Imbhuailtí bóthair tromchúiseacha in aice láimhe
road_danger.description: Imbhuailtí bóthair inar maraíodh nó inar gortaíodh duine go dona laistigh de 500m de thithe, sa bhliain (meán 5 bliana).

iod_crime.label: Fearann coireachta an innéacs díothachta
iod_crime.description: Riosca samhaltaithe íospairt phearsanta agus maoine (sonraí 2021–2023).

recorded_crime.label: Coireacht a taifeadadh (SIMD)
recorded_crime.description: Coireanna a taifeadadh in aghaidh 1,000 cónaitheoir sa bhliain in Innéacs Ildíothachta na hAlban 2020, tugtha chuig criosanna sonraí 2022.

no2.label: Dé-ocsaíd nítrigine (NO₂)
no2.description: Meán-NO₂ cúlra bliantúil san áit a gcónaíonn daoine (samhail 1km Defra; in Éirinn, léarscáil 1km an EEA).

pm25.label: Mínfhíneáin (PM2.5)
pm25.description: Meán-PM2.5 cúlra bliantúil san áit a gcónaíonn daoine (samhail 1km Defra; in Éirinn, léarscáil 1km an EEA).

green_space_access.label: Páirceanna agus spásanna glasa in aice láimhe
green_space_access.description: Bealaí isteach i bpáirceanna, i ngairdíní agus i bpáirceanna imeartha poiblí laistigh de shiúlóid 1km, ualaithe de réir faid (i dTuaisceart Éireann agus in Éirinn, páirceanna agus páirceanna imeartha OpenStreetMap).

play_spaces.label: Clóis súgartha in aice láimhe
play_spaces.description: Bealaí isteach i spásanna súgartha poiblí laistigh de 800m de thithe, ualaithe de réir faid (i dTuaisceart Éireann agus in Éirinn, clóis súgartha OpenStreetMap).

flood_risk.label: Tithe i mbaol tuilte
flood_risk.description: Sciar de thithe i mbaol ard nó meánach tuilte ó aibhneacha, ón bhfarraige nó ó uisce dromchla (seans 1% sa bhliain ar a laghad).

flood_rivers_sea.label: Tithe i mbaol ó aibhneacha nó ón bhfarraige
flood_rivers_sea.description: Sciar de thithe i mbaol ard nó meánach tuilte ó aibhneacha nó ón bhfarraige amháin (seans 1% sa bhliain ar a laghad).

noise_exposure.label: Tithe i dtorann iompair nó tionsclaíoch
noise_exposure.description: Sciar de thithe ina sroicheann torann mapáilte 60 dB Lden nó níos mó thar an lá, an tráthnóna agus an oíche (bóithre, iarnróid agus aerárthaí i Sasana; bóithre agus iarnróid sa Bhreatain Bheag; gach foinse mhapáilte in Albain).

aircraft_noise.label: Tithe i dtorann aerárthaí
aircraft_noise.description: Sciar de thithe ina bhfuil torann aerárthaí 55 dB Lden nó níos mó ar an meán, timpeall na sé aerfort déag atá mapáilte i Sasana, Aerfort Chathair Bhéal Feirste, agus Baile Átha Cliath, Corcaigh agus an tSionainn.

industrial_noise.label: Tithe i dtorann tionsclaíoch
industrial_noise.description: Sciar de thithe ina bhfuil torann tionsclaíoch 55 dB Lden nó níos mó ar an meán, timpeall suíomhanna mapáilte na Breataine Bige, i gcúig chathair mhapáilte na hAlban.

night_noise.label: Tithe i dtorann oíche
night_noise.description: Sciar de thithe ina bhfuil torann mapáilte 50 dB Lnight nó níos mó ar an meán idir 23:00 agus 07:00, an leibhéal ag a n-áiríonn an Treoir um Thorann Comhshaoil daoine a bheith nochta dó san oíche.

road_rail_noise.label: Tithe i dtorann bóthair nó iarnróid
road_rail_noise.description: Sciar de thithe ina sroicheann torann bóthair nó iarnróid 60 dB Lden nó níos mó thar an lá, an tráthnóna agus an oíche, ó na mapaí torainn straitéiseacha.

coast_distance.label: Fad go dtí an cósta
coast_distance.description: Fad ó thithe go dtí an cósta is gaire, i gciliméadair (marc an lán mara sa Bhreatain Mhór, líne uisce na farraige ar an léarscáil náisiúnta in Éirinn, imlíne Thuaisceart Éireann).

tree_canopy.label: Clúdach crann timpeall tithe
tree_canopy.description: Sciar den talamh laistigh de 500m de thithe a rangaíonn clúdach talún satailíte mar chlúdach crann (ESA WorldCover, 10m).

light_pollution.label: Solas na hoíche
light_pollution.description: Meánradaíocht oíche laistigh de 1km de thithe, ó chomhiomlán bliantúil satailíte VIIRS (nW/cm²/sr).

iod_outdoors.label: Timpeallacht chónaithe amuigh IoD 2025
iod_outdoors.description: Cáilíocht aeir agus timpistí tráchta bóthair (fofhearann IoD 2025).

hospital_ae_distance.label: Fad chuig an rannóg éigeandála is gaire
hospital_ae_distance.description: Meánfhad díreach ó thithe chuig an rannóg éigeandála is gaire faoi stiúir comhairleora.

hospital_distance.label: Fad chuig an gcúram éigeandála is gaire
hospital_distance.description: Meánfhad díreach ó thithe chuig an rannóg éigeandála nó an t-aonad mionghortuithe is gaire.

gp_distance.label: Fad chuig an gcleachtas dochtúra teaghlaigh is gaire
gp_distance.description: Meánfhad díreach ó thithe chuig an gcleachtas dochtúra teaghlaigh is gaire.

patients_per_gp.label: Othair in aghaidh an dochtúra teaghlaigh
patients_per_gp.description: Othair chláraithe in aghaidh an dochtúra teaghlaigh cháilithe lánaimseartha ag na cleachtais a úsáideann cónaitheoirí.

gp_quality.label: Rátálacha cleachtas dochtúirí teaghlaigh
gp_quality.description: Rátálacha CQC na gcleachtas dochtúirí teaghlaigh a bhfuil cónaitheoirí cláraithe leo, ualaithe de réir an lín a úsáideann gach ceann.

care_homes.label: Tithe altranais dea-rátáilte in aice láimhe
care_homes.description: Leapacha i dtithe altranais a rátáil CQC Maith nó Sármhaith laistigh de 5km, ualaithe de réir faid.

pharmacy_distance.label: Fad chuig an gcógaslann is gaire
pharmacy_distance.description: Meánfhad díreach ó thithe chuig an gcógaslann phobail NHS is gaire.

dentist_distance.label: Fad chuig an bhfiaclóir NHS is gaire
dentist_distance.description: Meánfhad díreach ó thithe chuig an gcleachtas fiaclóireachta is gaire a bhfuil conradh NHS aige.

primary_school_quality.label: Bunscoileanna maithe in aice láimhe
primary_school_quality.description: Cáilíocht na dtrí bhunscoil stáit is gaire (Ofsted agus torthaí), agus na cinn is gaire ag comhaireamh níos mó.

secondary_school_quality.label: Meánscoileanna maithe in aice láimhe
secondary_school_quality.description: Cáilíocht na dtrí mheánscoil stáit is gaire (cigireachtaí agus torthaí), agus na cinn is gaire ag comhaireamh níos mó.

school_choice.label: Rogha scoileanna maithe
school_choice.description: Bunscoileanna stáit maithe laistigh de 2km agus meánscoileanna laistigh de 5km, ualaithe de réir cáilíochta agus faid.

primary_results.label: Torthaí bunscoile in aice láimhe
primary_results.description: Sciar de dhaltaí a shroicheann an caighdeán a bhfuiltear ag súil leis sa léitheoireacht, sa scríbhneoireacht agus sa mhatamaitic ag bunscoileanna stáit laistigh de 2km (meán 3 bliana), ualaithe de réir faid.

secondary_results.label: Torthaí meánscoile in aice láimhe
secondary_results.description: Meánscór Gnóthachtáil 8 ag meánscoileanna stáit laistigh de 5km, ualaithe de réir faid.

nursery_access.label: Naíonraí maithe in aice láimhe
nursery_access.description: Naíonraí, réamhscoileanna agus ranganna naíonra scoile laistigh de 1km, gach ceann ualaithe de réir a ghráid chigireachta agus faid.

connectivity_overall.label: Nascacht iomlán
connectivity_overall.description: Scór nascachta DfT thar gach modh taistil agus ceann scríbe.

connectivity_public_transport.label: Nascacht iompair phoiblí
connectivity_public_transport.description: Scór nascachta DfT d'iompar poiblí chuig gach ceann scríbe.

connectivity_walking.label: Insiúltacht
connectivity_walking.description: Scór nascachta DfT do shiúl chuig gach ceann scríbe.

connectivity_cycling.label: Nascacht rothaíochta
connectivity_cycling.description: Scór nascachta DfT do rothaíocht chuig gach ceann scríbe.

access_deprivation.label: Rochtain ar sheirbhísí (SIMD agus NIMDM)
access_deprivation.description: Fearann rochtana geografaí Innéacs Ildíothachta na hAlban 2020 (agus fearann gaireacht seirbhísí NIMDM 2017 i dTuaisceart Éireann): amanna tiomána agus iompair phoiblí chuig dochtúirí teaghlaigh, scoileanna, siopaí, oifigí poist agus stáisiúin pheitril, tugtha chuig criosanna 2021 agus 2022.

station_distance.label: Fad chuig an stáisiún is gaire
station_distance.description: Meánfhad díreach ó thithe chuig an stad iarnróid, meitreo nó trama is gaire.

rail_service.label: Seirbhís iarnróid in aice láimhe
rail_service.description: Iontrálacha agus imeachtaí bliantúla stáisiúin (ORR) laistigh de 2km de thithe, ualaithe de réir faid agus sáithithe, sa chaoi go gcomhaireann stáisiún gnóthach in aice láimhe níos mó ná stad beag.

bus_frequency.label: Minicíocht busanna
bus_frequency.description: Busanna san uair (laethanta na seachtaine, 07:00–19:00) ag an stad is gnóthaí laistigh de 400m de thithe.

bus_access.label: Seirbhís bus in aice láimhe
bus_access.description: Busanna san uair (laethanta na seachtaine, 07:00–19:00) ag an stad is gnóthaí laistigh de 400m de thithe, ó amchláir Transport for Ireland; seasann sé in ionad an scóir nascachta nach bhfuil ag Éirinn.

gigabit_broadband.label: Leathanbhanda gigibheart
gigabit_broadband.description: Sciar de thithe ar féidir leo leathanbhanda ar chumas gigibhirt a fháil (snáithín iomlán nó cábla).

slow_broadband.label: Tithe gan leathanbhanda cuibheasach
slow_broadband.description: Sciar de thithe nach féidir leo leathanbhanda 10 Mbit/s a fháil ó líne sheasta ná ó gan sreang seasta.

well_run_pubs.label: Tithe tábhairne dea-reáchtáilte in aice láimhe
well_run_pubs.description: Tithe tábhairne laistigh de shiúlóid 15 nóiméad a bhfuil rátáil sláinteachais bia 4 nó 5 acu ó na trí bliana seo caite, ualaithe de réir faid.

food_and_drink.label: Caiféanna agus bialanna
food_and_drink.description: Caiféanna agus bialanna laistigh de 800m, ualaithe de réir faid.

supermarket_distance.label: Fad chuig an ollmhargadh is gaire
supermarket_distance.description: Meánfhad díreach ó thithe chuig an ollmhargadh is gaire.

everyday_services.label: Seirbhísí laethúla laistigh de 15 nóiméad
everyday_services.description: Sciar de na seacht gcineál seirbhíse laethúla (cleachtas dochtúra teaghlaigh, cógaslann, ollmhargadh, bunscoil, oifig an phoist, páirc nó clós súgartha, agus iompar poiblí minic) atá ag an ngnáth-theach laistigh de 1.2 km, timpeall 15 nóiméad siúil i líne dhíreach.

library_distance.label: Fad go leabharlann
library_distance.description: Meánfhad i líne dhíreach ó thithe go dtí an leabharlann phoiblí is gaire (OpenStreetMap).

post_office_distance.label: Fad go hoifig an phoist
post_office_distance.description: Meánfhad i líne dhíreach ó thithe go dtí oifig an phoist is gaire (OpenStreetMap).

shops.label: Siopaí in aice láimhe
shops.description: Siopaí de gach cineál laistigh de 800m, ualaithe de réir faid.

leisure.label: Áiseanna spóirt agus aclaíochta
leisure.description: Ionaid spóirt, giomanna agus linnte snámha atá ar oscailt don phobal laistigh de 2km, ualaithe de réir faid (OpenStreetMap).

leisure_facilities.label: Áiseanna spóirt (Active Places)
leisure_facilities.description: Hallaí spóirt, giomanna, linnte, stiúideonna, cúirteanna agus páirceanna atá ar oscailt don phobal laistigh de 2km i gclár Active Places Sport England, ualaithe de réir faid.

swimming_pool_distance.label: Fad chuig an linn snámha phoiblí is gaire
swimming_pool_distance.description: Meánfhad díreach ó thithe chuig an linn snámha is gaire atá ar oscailt don phobal.

culture.label: Leabharlanna, pictiúrlanna, amharclanna agus músaeim
culture.description: Leabharlanna, pictiúrlanna, amharclanna, ionaid ealaíon, músaeim agus dánlanna laistigh de 2km.

gambling.label: Siopaí geallghlacadóra agus casaínónna in aice láimhe
gambling.description: Siopaí geallghlacadóra, ionaid chearrbhachais agus casaínónna laistigh de 800m.

house_price.label: Praghas tí tipiciúil
house_price.description: Praghas díola meánach thar an 12 mhí seo caite, cobhsaithe i dtreo an cheantair máguaird nuair is beag díolachán atá ann.

housing_condition.label: Bail na tithíochta
housing_condition.description: Fearann tithíochta an innéacs díothachta (tithe i ndroch-chaoi nó gan téamh lárnach; in Albain, plódú agus gan téamh lárnach; i dTuaisceart Éireann, an timpeallacht mhaireachtála).

price_change.label: Athrú ar phraghsanna tithe
price_change.description: Athrú ar an bpraghas díola meánach, an 12 mhí seo caite i gcomparáid leis an 12 mhí roimhe sin.

council_tax.label: Cáin chomhairle (ráta Bhanda D na comhairle)
council_tax.description: Muirear bliantúil na comhairle ar theach Bhanda D, lena n-áirítear muirir chontae, phóilíní, dóiteáin agus paróiste ar an meán; an ráta mar a chéile a fhoilsíonn gach comhairle.

domestic_rates.label: Rátaí tí (teach tipiciúil)
domestic_rates.description: Bille rátaí tí bliantúil do theach ag meánluach caipitil an cheantair, ón ráta réigiúnach agus ó ráta ceantair na comhairle (Tuaisceart Éireann).

council_tax_typical.label: Cáin chomhairle (teach tipiciúil anseo)
council_tax_typical.description: An méid a íocann teach tipiciúil sa cheantar i gcáin chomhairle, muirear gach banda ualaithe de réir an lín tithe sa cheantar atá sa bhanda sin.

price_to_income.label: Praghas i gcomparáid le hioncam áitiúil
price_to_income.description: Praghas tí tipiciúil roinnte ar mheánioncam glan teaghlaigh an cheantair.

new_builds.label: Tithe a tógadh ó 2000
new_builds.description: Sciar de thithe a tógadh in 2000 nó ina dhiaidh.

period_homes.label: Tithe a tógadh roimh 1919
period_homes.description: Sciar de thithe a tógadh roimh 1919.

lower_band_homes.label: Tithe i mbandaí cánach comhairle A–B
lower_band_homes.description: Sciar de thithe sa dá bhanda cánach comhairle is ísle (na tithe is saoire ag luachanna 1991).

income_deprivation.label: Díothacht ioncaim
income_deprivation.description: Sciar de chónaitheoirí ar ioncam íseal (fearann ioncaim an innéacs díothachta).

pobal_deprivation.label: Rachmas agus díothacht (innéacs Pobal HP)
pobal_deprivation.description: Innéacs díothachta coibhneasta Pobal HP na toghroinne ó Dhaonáireamh 2022 (dífhostaíocht, oideachas, aicme shóisialta, tuismitheoirí aonair, tionacht agus plódú); ciallaíonn níos airde níos saibhre.

employment_deprivation.label: Díothacht fostaíochta
employment_deprivation.description: Sciar de chónaitheoirí in aois oibre atá dífhostaithe dá n-ainneoin féin (fearann fostaíochta an innéacs díothachta).

claimant_rate.label: Ráta éilitheoirí
claimant_rate.description: Cónaitheoirí ag éileamh sochar a bhaineann le dífhostaíocht, mar sciar de na daoine 16–64 (an mhí is déanaí).

household_income.label: Ioncam teaghlaigh
household_income.description: Meánioncam glan teaghlaigh sa cheantar níos leithne (MSOA), roimh chostais tithíochta.

health_deprivation.label: Sláinte agus míchumas
health_deprivation.description: Bás roimh am, tinneas agus míchumas (fearann díothachta sláinte agus míchumais an innéacs díothachta).

life_expectancy.label: Ionchas saoil
life_expectancy.description: Ionchas saoil ag breith sa cheantar níos leithne (MSOA), meán fear agus ban, 2019–23.

good_health.label: Dea-shláinte (féintuairiscithe)
good_health.description: Cónaitheoirí a thuairiscíonn a sláinte mar mhaith nó an-mhaith (Daonáireamh 2021; 2022 in Albain).

imd.label: Innéacs Ildíothachta
imd.description: Scór díothachta iomlán; gan scór mar forluíonn a fhearainn ar tháscairí eile.

population_density.label: Dlús daonra
population_density.description: Cónaitheoirí in aghaidh an chiliméadair chearnaigh (Daonáireamh 2021; 2022 in Albain).

households_with_children.label: Teaghlaigh le leanaí cleithiúnacha
households_with_children.description: Sciar de theaghlaigh le leanaí cleithiúnacha (Daonáireamh 2021; 2022 in Albain).

aged_65_plus.label: Cónaitheoirí 65 nó níos sine
aged_65_plus.description: Sciar de chónaitheoirí atá 65 bliana d'aois nó níos sine (Daonáireamh 2021; 2022 in Albain).

owner_occupied.label: Tithe úinéir-áitithe
owner_occupied.description: Sciar de theaghlaigh ar leo a dteach go hiomlán nó le morgáiste (Daonáireamh 2021; 2022 in Albain).

no_car.label: Teaghlaigh gan charr
no_car.description: Sciar de theaghlaigh gan charr ná veain (Daonáireamh 2021; 2022 in Albain).

sustainable_commute.label: Siúl, rothaíocht nó iompar poiblí chun na hoibre
sustainable_commute.description: Sciar d'oibrithe a thaistealaíonn chun na hoibre de shiúl na gcos, ar rothar nó ar iompar poiblí (Daonáireamh 2021, le linn srianta COVID-19; 2022 in Albain).

sunshine.label: Grian
sunshine.description: Uaireanta de sholas geal na gréine sa bhliain, meán 1991–2020 (HadUK-Grid, 1km).

wet_days.label: Laethanta fliucha
wet_days.description: Laethanta sa bhliain le 1mm báistí ar a laghad, meán 1991–2020.

summer_warmth.label: Teas an tsamhraidh
summer_warmth.description: Meánteocht uasta laethúil ó Mheitheamh go Lúnasa, meán 1991–2020 (°C).

winter_mildness.label: Séimhe an gheimhridh
winter_mildness.description: Meánteocht íosta laethúil ó Nollaig go Feabhra, meán 1991–2020 (°C).

rainfall.label: Báisteach
rainfall.description: Báisteach sa bhliain i milliméadair, meán 1991–2020.

rainfall_total.label: Báisteach bhliantúil
rainfall_total.description: Meánbháisteach sa bhliain, 1991–2020, ó ghreille 1 km Met Éireann; seasann sé in ionad laethanta fliucha.

air_frost_days.label: Laethanta sioc aeir
air_frost_days.description: Laethanta sa bhliain nuair a thiteann teocht an aeir faoi 0°C, meán 1991–2020.

summer_days.label: Laethanta samhraidh
summer_days.description: Laethanta sa bhliain nuair a shroicheann an teocht 25°C, meán 1991–2020.

snow_days.label: Laethanta le sneachta ina luí
snow_days.description: Laethanta sa bhliain le sneachta ar an talamh ag 9rn, meán 1991–2020.

future_hot_days.label: Laethanta teo samhraidh i ndomhan 2°C níos teo
future_hot_days.description: Laethanta sa bhliain le huasteocht os cionn 30°C nuair a bheidh an domhan 2°C níos teo, ó réamh-mheastacháin áitiúla UKCP18 Oifig na hAimsire.

gp_list_size.label: Othair in aghaidh an chleachtais dochtúra teaghlaigh in aice láimhe
gp_list_size.description: Othair chláraithe in aghaidh an chleachtais ag na cleachtais dochtúirí teaghlaigh in aice le tithe, ualaithe de réir faid.

allotment_distance.label: Fad chuig na leithdháiltí is gaire
allotment_distance.description: Meánfhad díreach ó thithe chuig na leithdháiltí nó an spás fáis pobail is gaire.

radon_potential.label: Tithe i limistéar ard radóin
radon_potential.description: Sciar na dtithe i gcearnóga greille ina meastar go mbeidh breis is 10% de thithe os cionn leibhéal gnímh an radóin (atlas táscach BGS agus UKHSA; léarscáil radóin an EPA in Éirinn).

ev_charging.label: Pointí luchtaithe poiblí in aice láimhe
ev_charging.description: Láithreáin luchtaithe feithiclí leictreacha poiblí laistigh de 1.5km de thithe, ar an meán (OpenStreetMap, ESB ar oileán na hÉireann, Open Charge Map).

listed_buildings.label: Foirgnimh liostaithe in aice láimhe
listed_buildings.description: Foirgnimh liostaithe laistigh de 1km de thithe, in aghaidh an km² (Historic England, Cadw, Historic Environment Scotland agus an Roinn Pobal; in Éirinn, an Fardal Náisiúnta d'Oidhreacht Ailtireachta ag rátáil réigiúnach nó níos airde).

safety.label: Sàbhailteachd
safety.description: Eucoir agus giùlan mì-shòisealta a chaidh a chlàradh far a bheil daoine a' fuireach.

environment.label: Àrainneachd
environment.description: Èadhar glan, sràidean sàmhach, craobhan agus àiteachan uaine faisg air làimh, agus cunnart tuil.

health.label: Seirbheisean slàinte
health.description: Dè cho furasta 's a tha e do luchd-còmhnaidh dotair-teaghlaich, cungadair no fiaclair fhaicinn.

education.label: Sgoiltean agus cùram-chloinne
education.description: Sgoiltean agus sgoiltean-àraich math taobh a-staigh ruigsinn.

transport.label: Còmhdhail agus ceangalachd
transport.description: Dè cho math 's a tha sgìre a' ceangal ri obraichean agus seirbheisean air gach dòigh, agus a bann-leathann.

amenities.label: Goireasan agus beatha na h-oidhche
amenities.description: Bùthan, cafaidhean, taighean-seinnse math, cur-seachadan agus cultar faisg air làimh.

housing.label: Taigheadas agus cosgaisean
housing.description: Na chosgas dachaighean agus staid an stoc thaighean.

community.label: Coimhearsnachd agus sunnd
community.description: Teachd-a-steach, obair agus slàinte nan daoine a tha a' fuireach ann.

climate.label: Gnàth-shìde
climate.description: Grian, uisge agus cho blàth 's a tha an samhradh agus cho ciùin 's a tha an geamhradh, bho chuibheasachdan deich bliadhna fichead.

balanced.label: Cothromaichte
balanced.description: Tha gach cuspair a' cunntadh gu co-ionann.

family.label: Teaghlach le clann
family.description: Sgoiltean agus sgoiltean-àraich math, sàbhailteachd agus àiteachan uaine an toiseach.

young_professional.label: Proifeiseantach òg
young_professional.description: Ceanglaichean, rudan ri dhèanamh agus taighean-seinnse math; chan eil sgoiltean cho cudromach.

retiree.label: Air cluaineas
retiree.description: Sàbhailteachd, seirbheisean slàinte, èadhar glan agus sgìre nas sàmhaiche.

commuter.label: Neach-siubhail
commuter.description: Ceanglaichean luath ri obraichean, air còmhdhail phoblach gu h-àraidh.

flags.imputed: Is e tuairmsean a th' anns na figearan eucoir an seo: chan eil Poileas Greater Manchester a' foillseachadh dàta aig ìre sràide.
flags.low_n: Cha deach ach beagan dhachaighean a reic an seo sa bhliadhna a dh'fhalbh, mar sin tha a' phrìs air a daingneachadh a dh'ionnsaigh na sgìre mun cuairt.
flags.broadcast_lad: Tha càileachd nan àrd-sgoiltean a' tighinn bho thoraidhean deuchainnean na comhairle gu lèir, oir chan eil an nàisean seo a' foillseachadh thoraidhean no ìrean sgrùdaidh airson gach sgoil.
flags.not_available: Chan eil cuid de thaisbeanairean ri fhaighinn san nàisean seo fhathast; tha an cuspair a' cleachdadh na tha aige.
flags.theme_gap: Tha ro bheag de dhàta fosgailte aig an nàisean seo airson aon chuspair a sgòradh: tha e air a shealltainn mar dhàta cuingealaichte agus air fhàgail a-mach às an iomlan.

crime_violence.label: Eucoirean fòirneart agus gnèitheasach
crime_violence.description: Fòirneart agus eucoirean gnèitheasach a chaidh a chlàradh gach 1,000 luchd-còmhnaidh sa bhliadhna (cuibheas 36 mìosan).

crime_burglary.label: Bristeadh a-steach
crime_burglary.description: Bristidhean a-steach a chaidh a chlàradh gach 1,000 luchd-còmhnaidh sa bhliadhna.

crime_asb.label: Giùlan mì-shòisealta
crime_asb.description: Tachartasan giùlain mhì-shòisealta a chaidh aithris gach 1,000 luchd-còmhnaidh sa bhliadhna.

crime_theft.label: Robaireachd, mèirle agus eucoir charbadan
crime_theft.description: Robaireachd, mèirle bhon neach, eucoir charbadan agus mèirle bhaidhsagalan gach 1,000 luchd-còmhnaidh sa bhliadhna.

crime_damage_disorder.label: Milleadh eucorach agus òrdugh poblach
crime_damage_disorder.description: Milleadh eucorach, losgadh-dhìol agus eucoirean òrduigh phoblaich gach 1,000 luchd-còmhnaidh sa bhliadhna.

road_danger.label: Tubaistean rathaid trom faisg air làimh
road_danger.description: Tubaistean rathaid anns an deach cuideigin a mharbhadh no a leòn gu trom taobh a-staigh 500m de dhachaighean, sa bhliadhna (cuibheas 5 bliadhna).

iod_crime.label: Raon eucoir a' chlàr-amais bochdainn
iod_crime.description: Cunnart modailte de dh'fhulangas pearsanta agus seilbhe (dàta 2021–2023).

recorded_crime.label: Eucoir a chaidh a chlàradh (SIMD)
recorded_crime.description: Eucoirean a chaidh a chlàradh gach 1,000 luchd-còmhnaidh sa bhliadhna ann an Clàr-amais Ioma-bhochdainn na h-Alba 2020, air an toirt gu sònaichean dàta 2022.

no2.label: Dà-ogsaid naitridean (NO₂)
no2.description: NO₂ cùil cuibheasach bliadhnail far a bheil luchd-còmhnaidh a' fuireach (modail 1km Defra; ann an Èirinn, mapa 1km an EEA).

pm25.label: Mìon-ghràineanan (PM2.5)
pm25.description: PM2.5 cùil cuibheasach bliadhnail far a bheil luchd-còmhnaidh a' fuireach (modail 1km Defra; ann an Èirinn, mapa 1km an EEA).

green_space_access.label: Pàircean agus àiteachan uaine faisg air làimh
green_space_access.description: Dorsan a-steach gu pàircean, gàrraidhean agus raointean-cluiche poblach taobh a-staigh coiseachd 1km, air an cuideamachadh a rèir astair (ann an Èirinn a Tuath agus ann an Èirinn, pàircean agus raointean OpenStreetMap).

play_spaces.label: Raointean-cluiche faisg air làimh
play_spaces.description: Dorsan a-steach gu raointean-cluiche poblach taobh a-staigh 800m de dhachaighean, air an cuideamachadh a rèir astair (ann an Èirinn a Tuath agus ann an Èirinn, raointean-cluiche OpenStreetMap).

flood_risk.label: Dachaighean ann an cunnart tuil
flood_risk.description: Cuid de dhachaighean ann an cunnart àrd no meadhanach tuil bho aibhnichean, bhon mhuir no bho uisge-uachdair (co-dhiù 1% de sheans sa bhliadhna).

flood_rivers_sea.label: Dachaighean ann an cunnart bho aibhnichean no bhon mhuir
flood_rivers_sea.description: Cuid de dhachaighean ann an cunnart àrd no meadhanach tuil bho aibhnichean no bhon mhuir a-mhàin (co-dhiù 1% de sheans sa bhliadhna).

noise_exposure.label: Dachaighean ann am fuaim còmhdhail no gnìomhachais
noise_exposure.description: Cuid de dhachaighean far a bheil fuaim mapaichte a' ruighinn 60 dB Lden no barrachd thar an latha, an fheasgair agus na h-oidhche (rathaidean agus rèile ann an Sasainn agus sa Chuimrigh; gach tùs mapaichte ann an Alba).

aircraft_noise.label: Dachaighean ann am fuaim itealain
aircraft_noise.description: Cuid de na dachaighean far a bheil fuaim itealain a' cuibheasachadh 55 dB Lden no barrachd, timcheall nan sia puirt-adhair deug a tha air am mapadh ann an Sasainn.

industrial_noise.label: Dachaighean ann am fuaim gnìomhachais
industrial_noise.description: Cuid de na dachaighean far a bheil fuaim gnìomhachais a' cuibheasachadh 55 dB Lden no barrachd, timcheall làraichean mapaichte na Cuimrigh, ann an còig bailtean mapaichte na h-Alba.

night_noise.label: Dachaighean ann am fuaim na h-oidhche
night_noise.description: Cuid de na dachaighean far a bheil fuaim mhapaichte a' cuibheasachadh 50 dB Lnight no barrachd eadar 23:00 agus 07:00, an ìre aig a bheil an Stiùireadh Fuaim Àrainneachdail a' cunntadh dhaoine mar fhosgailte dhi air an oidhche.

road_rail_noise.label: Dachaighean ann am fuaim rathaid no rèile
road_rail_noise.description: Cuid de dhachaighean far a bheil fuaim rathaid no rèile a' ruighinn 60 dB Lden no barrachd thar an latha, an fheasgair agus na h-oidhche, bho na mapaichean fuaim ro-innleachdail.

coast_distance.label: Astar chun a' chladaich
coast_distance.description: Astar bho dhachaighean chun a' chladaich as fhaisge, ann an cilemeatairean (comharra àrd-làin ann am Breatainn Mhòr, loidhne uisge na mara a' mhapa nàiseanta ann an Èirinn, iomall-crìche Èirinn a Tuath).

tree_canopy.label: Còmhdach chraobhan timcheall dhachaighean
tree_canopy.description: Cuid den fhearann taobh a-staigh 500m de dhachaighean a tha còmhdach-fearainn saideil a' seòrsachadh mar chòmhdach chraobhan (ESA WorldCover, 10m).

light_pollution.label: Solas na h-oidhche
light_pollution.description: Deàrrsadh oidhche cuibheasach taobh a-staigh 1km de dhachaighean, bho cho-mheasgachadh bliadhnail saideil VIIRS (nW/cm²/sr).

iod_outdoors.label: Àrainneachd-còmhnaidh a-muigh IoD 2025
iod_outdoors.description: Càileachd èadhair agus tubaistean trafaig rathaid (fo-raon IoD 2025).

hospital_ae_distance.label: Astar chun an A&E as fhaisge
hospital_ae_distance.description: Astar dìreach cuibheasach bho dhachaighean chun na roinn èiginn fo stiùir co-chomhairliche as fhaisge.

hospital_distance.label: Astar chun a' chùraim èiginnich as fhaisge
hospital_distance.description: Astar dìreach cuibheasach bho dhachaighean chun na roinn èiginn no an aonaid mhion-leòntan as fhaisge.

gp_distance.label: Astar chun a' chleachdaidh dhotair-teaghlaich as fhaisge
gp_distance.description: Astar dìreach cuibheasach bho dhachaighean chun a' chleachdaidh dhotair-teaghlaich as fhaisge.

patients_per_gp.label: Euslaintich gach dotair-teaghlaich
patients_per_gp.description: Euslaintich clàraichte gach dotair-teaghlaich teisteanaichte làn-ùine aig na cleachdaidhean a bhios luchd-còmhnaidh a' cleachdadh.

gp_quality.label: Rangachaidhean chleachdaidhean dhotairean-teaghlaich
gp_quality.description: Rangachaidhean CQC nan cleachdaidhean dhotairean-teaghlaich air a bheil luchd-còmhnaidh clàraichte, air an cuideamachadh a rèir cia mheud a chleachdas gach fear.

care_homes.label: Dachaighean-cùraim le deagh rangachadh faisg air làimh
care_homes.description: Leapannan ann an dachaighean-cùraim air an rangachadh Math no Air leth le CQC taobh a-staigh 5km, air an cuideamachadh a rèir astair.

pharmacy_distance.label: Astar chun a' chungadair as fhaisge
pharmacy_distance.description: Astar dìreach cuibheasach bho dhachaighean chun a' chungadair coimhearsnachd NHS as fhaisge.

dentist_distance.label: Astar chun an fhiaclair NHS as fhaisge
dentist_distance.description: Astar dìreach cuibheasach bho dhachaighean chun a' chleachdaidh fhiaclaireachd le cùmhnant NHS as fhaisge.

primary_school_quality.label: Bun-sgoiltean math faisg air làimh
primary_school_quality.description: Càileachd nan trì bun-sgoiltean stàite as fhaisge (Ofsted agus toraidhean), le feadhainn nas fhaisge a' cunntadh barrachd.

secondary_school_quality.label: Àrd-sgoiltean math faisg air làimh
secondary_school_quality.description: Càileachd nan trì àrd-sgoiltean stàite as fhaisge (sgrùdaidhean agus toraidhean), le feadhainn nas fhaisge a' cunntadh barrachd.

school_choice.label: Roghainn de sgoiltean math
school_choice.description: Bun-sgoiltean stàite math taobh a-staigh 2km agus àrd-sgoiltean taobh a-staigh 5km, air an cuideamachadh a rèir càileachd agus astair.

primary_results.label: Toraidhean bun-sgoile faisg air làimh
primary_results.description: Cuid de sgoilearan a' ruighinn na h-ìre ris am biodh dùil ann an leughadh, sgrìobhadh agus matamataig aig bun-sgoiltean stàite taobh a-staigh 2km (cuibheas 3 bliadhna), air an cuideamachadh a rèir astair.

secondary_results.label: Toraidhean àrd-sgoile faisg air làimh
secondary_results.description: Sgòr Coileanadh 8 cuibheasach aig àrd-sgoiltean stàite taobh a-staigh 5km, air an cuideamachadh a rèir astair.

nursery_access.label: Sgoiltean-àraich math faisg air làimh
nursery_access.description: Sgoiltean-àraich, ro-sgoiltean agus clasaichean-àraich sgoile taobh a-staigh 1km, gach tè air a cuideamachadh a rèir a h-ìre sgrùdaidh agus astair.

connectivity_overall.label: Ceangalachd iomlan
connectivity_overall.description: Sgòr ceangalachd DfT thar gach dòigh-siubhail agus ceann-uidhe.

connectivity_public_transport.label: Ceangalachd còmhdhail phoblaich
connectivity_public_transport.description: Sgòr ceangalachd DfT airson còmhdhail phoblaich gu gach ceann-uidhe.

connectivity_walking.label: Coiseachdachd
connectivity_walking.description: Sgòr ceangalachd DfT airson coiseachd gu gach ceann-uidhe.

connectivity_cycling.label: Ceangalachd baidhsagail
connectivity_cycling.description: Sgòr ceangalachd DfT airson baidhsagal gu gach ceann-uidhe.

access_deprivation.label: Ruigsinneachd sheirbheisean (SIMD, NIMDM)
access_deprivation.description: Raon ruigsinneachd cruinn-eòlasach Clàr-amais Ioma-bhochdainn na h-Alba 2020 (ùineachan dràibhidh agus còmhdhail phoblaich gu dotairean-teaghlaich, sgoiltean, bùthan, oifisean-puist agus stèiseanan peatrail), air an toirt gu sònaichean dàta 2022.

station_distance.label: Astar chun an stèisein as fhaisge
station_distance.description: Astar dìreach cuibheasach bho dhachaighean chun an stad rèile, metro no trama as fhaisge.

rail_service.label: Seirbheis rèile faisg air làimh
rail_service.description: Inntrigidhean agus fàgail stèisein bliadhnail (ORR) taobh a-staigh 2km de dhachaighean, air an cuideamachadh a rèir astair agus a' sàsachadh, gus am bi stèisean trang faisg air làimh a' cunntadh barrachd na stad beag.

bus_frequency.label: Tricead bhusaichean
bus_frequency.description: Busaichean san uair (làithean-seachdain, 07:00–19:00) aig an stad as trainge taobh a-staigh 400m de dhachaighean.

bus_access.label: Seirbheis bhus faisg air làimh
bus_access.description: Busaichean san uair (làithean na seachdain, 07:00–19:00) aig an stad as trainge taobh a-staigh 400m de dhachaighean, bho chlàran-ama Transport for Ireland; a' seasamh an àite an sgòr ceangailteachd nach eil aig Èirinn.

gigabit_broadband.label: Bann-leathann gigabit
gigabit_broadband.description: Cuid de dhachaighean a gheibh bann-leathann comasach air gigabit (làn-fhreumhan no càball).

slow_broadband.label: Dachaighean gun bhann-leathann ceart

indicators.label: Violent and sexual offences
indicators.description: Recorded violence and sexual offences per 1,000 residents a year (36-month average from police.uk and the PSNI; in Ireland the latest year's Garda station counts, statistics under reservation, spread over the station's 2011 sub-district).
indicators.caveats: Rates use residents as the denominator, so town centres with few residents and many visitors score badly. Greater Manchester Police publishes no data; its area is estimated from IoD 2025's crime domain.

indicators.label: Burglary
indicators.description: Recorded burglaries per 1,000 residents a year.

indicators.label: Anti-social behaviour
indicators.description: Reported anti-social behaviour incidents per 1,000 residents a year.

indicators.label: Robbery, theft and vehicle crime
indicators.description: Robbery, theft from the person, vehicle crime and bicycle theft per 1,000 residents a year.

indicators.label: Criminal damage and public order
indicators.description: Criminal damage, arson and public order offences per 1,000 residents a year.

indicators.label: Serious road collisions nearby
indicators.description: Road collisions in which someone was killed or seriously injured within 500m of homes, per year (5-year average).
indicators.caveats: Busy roads near homes raise the count whoever was involved. Police forces moved to a new injury-reporting system at different times, which records more injuries as serious.

indicators.label: Deprivation index crime domain
indicators.description: Modelled risk of personal and material victimisation (the deprivation index's crime domain).

indicators.label: Recorded crime (SIMD)
indicators.description: Recorded crimes per 1,000 residents a year in the Scottish Index of Multiple Deprivation 2020, brought onto 2022 data zones.
indicators.caveats: Police Scotland publishes no open street-level data, so the SIMD rate stands in for the four crime indicators; it covers all recorded crime (violence, sexual offences, housebreaking, vandalism, drugs and common assault) and is older than the police.uk window used elsewhere.

indicators.label: Nitrogen dioxide (NO₂)
indicators.description: Annual mean background NO₂ where residents live (Defra 1km model; in Ireland, the EEA's 1km map).
indicators.caveats: Background concentrations; roadside levels on busy streets are higher. WHO guideline is 10 µg/m³.

indicators.label: Fine particles (PM2.5)
indicators.description: Annual mean background PM2.5 where residents live (Defra 1km model; in Ireland, the EEA's 1km map).
indicators.caveats: WHO guideline is 5 µg/m³.

indicators.label: Parks and green spaces nearby
indicators.description: Entrances to public parks, gardens and playing fields within a 1km walk, weighted by distance (in Northern Ireland and Ireland, OpenStreetMap parks and pitches).
indicators.caveats: Counts public parks and playing fields, not open countryside, so villages surrounded by fields and footpaths score lower than they feel. Northern Ireland has no open greenspace product, so its parks, gardens and pitches come from OpenStreetMap and are measured to the site's nearest edge rather than its entrances.

indicators.label: Play areas nearby
indicators.description: Entrances to public play spaces within 800m of homes, weighted by distance (in Northern Ireland and Ireland, OpenStreetMap playgrounds).

indicators.label: Distance to nearest allotments
indicators.description: Average straight-line distance from homes to the nearest allotments or community growing space.
indicators.caveats: Distance to the site, not whether a plot is free; waiting lists run to years in many towns. Northern Ireland's and Ireland's sites come from OpenStreetMap.

indicators.label: Homes in a high radon area
indicators.description: Share of homes in grid squares where more than 10% of homes are expected to exceed the radon action level (the BGS and UKHSA indicative atlas; the EPA's radon map in Ireland).
indicators.caveats: Indicative mapping by 1km square (10km in Ireland), not a measurement; the UKHSA postcode lookup or an EPA test gives a home's own level, and high levels can be reduced.

indicators.label: Homes at risk of flooding
indicators.description: Share of homes at high or medium risk of flooding from rivers, the sea or surface water (at least a 1% chance a year).
indicators.caveats: Each home is rated by the higher of the rivers-and-sea and surface-water assessments, which allow for flood defences; groundwater and sewer flooding are not included. England's counts are addresses, so shops on a flood-prone high street count too. In Wales, NRW publishes risk areas rather than counts, so homes at risk are estimated from the share of an area's property points inside the high and medium areas. Scotland's SEPA maps are read the same way, with the medium band at 1 in 200 a year (looser than the EA's 1 in 100).

indicators.label: Homes at risk from rivers or the sea
indicators.description: Share of homes at high or medium risk of flooding from rivers or the sea alone (at least a 1% chance a year).
indicators.caveats: The part of flood risk that comes from rivers and the sea; surface water is the rest. Flood defences are taken into account.

indicators.label: Homes in transport or industrial noise
indicators.description: Share of homes where mapped noise averages 60 dB Lden or more over the day, evening and night (road, rail and aircraft in England; road, rail and industry in Wales; every mapped source in Scotland, Northern Ireland and Ireland).
indicators.caveats: Each home is read from the 10m noise grid at its postcode and the loudest mapped source counts. England's maps hold road, rail and the sixteen mapped airports, Wales's road, rail and industry, Scotland's consolidated map every source including industry, and Northern Ireland's round 3 (2017) contours road, rail, industry and Belfast City Airport in the Belfast and Derry agglomerations plus the major roads and railways between them. The cut-off is 60 dB Lden, a busy road's level, because minor roads are mapped only inside the larger towns in England.

indicators.label: Homes in road or rail noise
indicators.description: Share of homes where road or rail noise averages 60 dB Lden or more over the day, evening and night, from the strategic noise maps.
indicators.caveats: Each home is read from the 10m noise grid at its postcode. England's maps cover every road inside the larger towns and cities and only major roads elsewhere, while Wales's cover every road, so the cut-off is 60 dB Lden, a busy road's level, rather than the 55 dB at which the Environmental Noise Directive counts people as exposed and at which ordinary streets would count only where they were mapped. Aircraft and industry are not included.

indicators.label: Homes in aircraft noise
indicators.description: Share of homes where aircraft noise averages 55 dB Lden or more over the day, evening and night, around the sixteen airports England maps, Belfast City Airport, and Dublin, Cork and Shannon.
indicators.caveats: The 55 dB Lden contours of Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, London City, Southend, Manchester, Liverpool, Birmingham, East Midlands, Leeds Bradford, Newcastle, Bristol, Bournemouth and Southampton for 2021, a year with fewer flights than usual; homes beyond those contours read 0 whatever smaller airfields they hear.

indicators.label: Homes in industrial noise
indicators.description: Share of homes where industrial noise averages 55 dB Lden or more over the day, evening and night, around Wales's mapped sites, in Scotland's five mapped cities, Northern Ireland's two agglomerations and Ireland's mapped sites.
indicators.caveats: Mapped only around Wales's industrial sites (2022 round), in Aberdeen, Dundee, Edinburgh, Falkirk and Glasgow, in Belfast and Derry (2017) and around Ireland's licensed industrial sites (EPA round 4); elsewhere in those nations the value is 0 rather than unknown.

indicators.label: Homes in night-time noise
indicators.description: Share of homes where mapped noise averages 50 dB Lnight or more between 23:00 and 07:00, the level at which the Environmental Noise Directive counts people as exposed at night (road, rail and aircraft in England; road, rail and industry in Wales; every mapped source in Scotland, Northern Ireland and Ireland).
indicators.caveats: The night-time companion of the daytime maps, read at each home from the same 10m grids and contours (England's road, rail and airport layers for 2021, Wales's 2022 road, rail and industry layers, Scotland's consolidated 2021 map, Northern Ireland's 2017 contours, Ireland's round 4 contours); the loudest mapped source counts. The 50 dB Lnight cut-off is the Directive's night reporting threshold, so an unmapped minor road reads as quiet here as it does by day.

indicators.label: Distance to the coast
indicators.description: Distance from homes to the nearest coast, in kilometres (the high water mark in Great Britain and Ireland, the Northern Ireland outline).
indicators.caveats: Straight-line distance to the nearest point of the mapped coastline, which runs up estuaries and sea loughs as far as the high water mark goes; a measure of nearness to the sea, not of beach access.

indicators.label: Tree cover around homes
indicators.description: Share of the land within 500m of homes that satellite land cover classes as tree cover (ESA WorldCover, 10m).
indicators.caveats: A 10m cell counts as tree cover when trees dominate it, so this reads roughly twice Forest Research's canopy survey (which samples points) while ranking wards much the same; single garden trees and hedges are missed. Water and unmapped cells are left out of the land total, so a seafront home is judged on the land behind it.

indicators.label: Night-time light
indicators.description: Average night-time radiance within 1km of homes, from the VIIRS satellite annual composite (nW/cm²/sr).
indicators.caveats: Brighter means more street and building lighting and so less of a view of the night sky; it tracks density and cuts both ways, which is why it is shown but not scored. The satellite is blind to the blue part of LED light, so newly converted streets read darker than they look.

indicators.label: Outdoor living environment (deprivation index)
indicators.description: Air quality and road traffic accidents (IoD 2025 and WIMD 2025 sub-domains).

indicators.label: Distance to nearest A&E
indicators.description: Average straight-line distance from homes to the nearest consultant-led emergency department.
indicators.caveats: Scotland's departments come from Public Health Scotland's list; England's and Wales's from OpenStreetMap hospitals tagged with an emergency department, which may include some minor injury units. Homes with nothing within 50km read 50km, the search cap, not a measured distance.

indicators.label: Distance to nearest urgent care
indicators.description: Average straight-line distance from homes to the nearest emergency department or minor injury unit.
indicators.caveats: Homes with nothing within 50km read 50km, the search cap, not a measured distance.

indicators.label: Distance to nearest GP practice
indicators.description: Average straight-line distance from homes to the nearest GP practice.

indicators.label: Patients per GP
indicators.description: Registered patients per full-time-equivalent qualified GP at the practices residents actually use.
indicators.caveats: Excludes GPs in training; practices reporting under one full-time GP are left out of the average.

indicators.label: Patients per GP practice nearby
indicators.description: Registered patients per practice at the GP practices near homes, weighted by distance.
indicators.caveats: Patients per practice, not per doctor: a large practice may have many GPs. The honest measure where GP headcounts are not published (everywhere but England).

indicators.label: GP practice ratings
indicators.description: CQC ratings of the GP practices residents are registered with, weighted by how many use each.
indicators.caveats: Most practices are rated Good, and some ratings are several years old.

indicators.label: Well-rated care homes nearby
indicators.description: Beds in care homes rated Good or Outstanding by CQC within 5km, weighted by distance.

indicators.label: Distance to nearest pharmacy
indicators.description: Average straight-line distance from homes to the nearest community pharmacy (NHS lists in Great Britain and Northern Ireland, OpenStreetMap in Wales and Ireland).
indicators.caveats: Rural GP practices that dispense medicines themselves aren't counted. Welsh pharmacies come from OpenStreetMap, since NWSSP's list is not machine-readable.

indicators.label: Distance to nearest NHS dentist
indicators.description: Average straight-line distance from homes to the nearest dental practice (with an NHS contract in the UK; OpenStreetMap in Ireland).
indicators.caveats: Whether a practice takes new NHS patients isn't published as open data.

indicators.label: Good primary schools nearby
indicators.description: Quality of the three nearest state primary schools (Ofsted and results), nearer ones counting more.
indicators.caveats: Quality blends Ofsted (60%) and key stage 2 results as a percentile (40%); results reflect intake as well as teaching. Distance isn't admission; oversubscribed schools admit by catchment or faith. Not available in Wales, Scotland or Northern Ireland, which publish no primary school results or inspection grades.

indicators.label: Good secondary schools nearby
indicators.description: Quality of the three nearest state secondary schools (Ofsted and results), nearer ones counting more.
indicators.caveats: Quality blends Ofsted (60%) and Attainment 8 as a percentile (40%); Progress 8 isn't published for 2024/25. In Wales, where no per-school results or inspection grades are published, the local authority's Capped 9 points score stands in for every school in it (flagged broadcast_lad). In Scotland quality is each school's average leaver tariff score as a percentile within Scotland; no inspection grades are published as open data.

indicators.label: Choice of good schools
indicators.description: Good state primaries within 2km and secondaries within 5km, weighted by quality and distance.

indicators.label: Primary school results nearby
indicators.description: Share of pupils meeting the expected standard in reading, writing and maths at state primaries within 2km (3-year average), weighted by distance.
indicators.caveats: Results reflect pupils' backgrounds as well as teaching; progress measures aren't published for 2024/25.

indicators.label: Secondary school results nearby
indicators.description: Average Attainment 8 score at state secondaries within 5km, weighted by distance.
indicators.caveats: Results reflect pupils' backgrounds as well as teaching; Progress 8 isn't published for 2024/25 and 2025/26.

indicators.label: Good nurseries nearby
indicators.description: Nurseries, pre-schools and school nursery classes within 1km, each weighted by its Ofsted grade and distance.
indicators.caveats: Childminders aren't located (Ofsted withholds their addresses). In Wales nurseries come from OpenStreetMap (CIW publishes no provider list) and count as average quality; school nursery classes are included from the Welsh schools list. In Scotland each nursery is weighted by its Care Inspectorate grades.

indicators.label: Overall connectivity
indicators.description: DfT connectivity score across all modes and destinations.

indicators.label: Public transport connectivity
indicators.description: DfT connectivity score for public transport to all destinations.

indicators.label: Walkability
indicators.description: DfT connectivity score for walking to all destinations.

indicators.label: Cycling connectivity
indicators.description: DfT connectivity score for cycling to all destinations.

indicators.label: Access to services (SIMD, NIMDM)
indicators.description: Geographic access domain of the Scottish Index of Multiple Deprivation 2020 (drive and public transport times to GPs, schools, shops, post offices and petrol stations), brought onto 2022 data zones; in Northern Ireland the NIMDM 2017 proximity to services domain.
indicators.caveats: Stands in for the DfT connectivity metric, which covers England and Wales only; a rank-based score within Scotland, so it says how an area compares with the rest of Scotland.

indicators.label: Distance to nearest station
indicators.description: Average straight-line distance from homes to the nearest railway, metro or tram stop.
indicators.caveats: Homes with nothing within 50km read 50km, the search cap, not a measured distance.

indicators.label: Public charge points nearby
indicators.description: Public electric-vehicle charging sites within 1.5km of homes, on average (OpenStreetMap, ESB on the island of Ireland, Open Charge Map).
indicators.caveats: Counts charging sites, not sockets or their speed, from OpenStreetMap, ESB's network on the island of Ireland and Open Charge Map's openly licensed providers (the last only when a build has a key); the UK's national chargepoint registry closed in 2024.

indicators.label: Rail service nearby
indicators.description: Annual station entries and exits (ORR) within 2km of homes, weighted by distance and saturating, so a busy station nearby counts more than a halt.
indicators.caveats: Mainline stations only (metro and tram stops count in the distance measure); usage is a proxy for service frequency, which the timetable licence does not allow us to compute.

indicators.label: Bus frequency
indicators.description: Buses an hour (weekdays, 07:00–19:00) at the busiest stop within 400m of homes.
indicators.caveats: Timetabled buses on a normal Tuesday. Shown, not scored, because DfT's connectivity score (scored) already covers bus access (ρ ≈ 0.82). Publishing to the Bus Open Data Service is voluntary in Scotland, so some Scottish operators are missing.

indicators.label: Bus service nearby
indicators.description: Buses an hour (weekdays, 07:00–19:00) at the busiest stop within 400m of homes, from the Transport for Ireland timetables; stands in for the connectivity score Ireland has no equivalent of.
indicators.caveats: Timetabled buses on a normal Tuesday, every operator in the national feed. A substitute for the DfT connectivity score, which weighs walking, cycling, driving and public transport to jobs and services; buses alone read thinner.

indicators.label: Gigabit broadband
indicators.description: Share of homes that can get gigabit-capable broadband (full fibre or cable).

indicators.label: Homes without decent broadband
indicators.description: Share of homes that can't get 10 Mbit/s broadband from a fixed line or fixed wireless.

indicators.label: Well-run pubs nearby
indicators.description: Pubs within a 15-minute walk that hold a food hygiene rating of 4 or 5 from the last three years, weighted by distance, with a small bonus for real ale, food or outdoor seating.
indicators.caveats: Hygiene ratings measure how well a pub is run, not the beer or the atmosphere. Scotland's hygiene scheme grades Pass or Improvement Required rather than 0–5 and inspects on a longer cycle, so there a pub counts as well run when it passed within the last five years.

indicators.label: Cafés and restaurants
indicators.description: Cafés and restaurants within 800m, weighted by distance.

indicators.label: Distance to nearest supermarket
indicators.description: Average straight-line distance from homes to the nearest supermarket.

indicators.label: Everyday services within 15 minutes
indicators.description: Share of seven everyday service types (a GP practice, a pharmacy, a supermarket, a primary school, a post office, a park or playground, and frequent public transport) that the typical home has within 1.2 km, about a 15-minute walk in a straight line.
indicators.caveats: Straight-line reach, not walking time, so a river or a railway between home and shop is not seen (a walking network is planned). Frequent transport means a stop with at least two weekday daytime departures an hour or a railway, metro or tram station. Ireland stages no school list, so its homes are measured over the other six types.

indicators.label: Distance to a library
indicators.description: Mean straight-line distance from homes to the nearest public library (OpenStreetMap).
indicators.caveats: Libraries as OpenStreetMap maps them; a council's list may be fuller.

indicators.label: Distance to a post office
indicators.description: Mean straight-line distance from homes to the nearest post office (OpenStreetMap).
indicators.caveats: Post offices as OpenStreetMap maps them, counters inside shops included where mapped.

indicators.label: Shops nearby
indicators.description: Shops of every kind within 800m, weighted by distance.

indicators.label: Sports and fitness facilities
indicators.description: Sports centres and gyms open to the public within 2km, weighted by distance (OpenStreetMap).
indicators.caveats: Mapped facilities, so a town's leisure centre counts once however many halls it has; swimming pools are left out because most mapped ones are private garden pools. Sport England's Active Places register (leisure_facilities) is the cross-check in England.

indicators.label: Sports facilities (Active Places)
indicators.description: Sports halls, gyms, pools, studios, courts and pitches open to the public within 2km in Sport England's Active Places register, weighted by distance.

indicators.label: Distance to nearest public pool
indicators.description: Average straight-line distance from homes to the nearest swimming pool open to the public.

indicators.label: Libraries, cinemas, theatres and museums
indicators.description: Libraries, cinemas, theatres, arts centres, museums and galleries within 2km.

indicators.label: Listed buildings nearby
indicators.description: Listed buildings within 1km of homes, per km² (Historic England, Cadw, Historic Environment Scotland and the Department for Communities; in Ireland, the National Inventory of Architectural Heritage at regional rating or above).
indicators.caveats: A density of protected buildings, as a sign of historic character; it says nothing about the condition of the homes, and Ireland's figure counts the inventory's recommendations rather than the councils' statutory records.

indicators.label: Fast-food outlets nearby
indicators.description: Fast-food outlets within 800m.

indicators.label: Betting shops and casinos nearby
indicators.description: Betting shops, gambling venues and casinos within 800m.

indicators.label: Typical house price
indicators.description: Median sale price over the last 12 months, steadied towards the surrounding area where sales are few.
indicators.caveats: Lower prices score as more affordable; the scale reflects price, not value. In Scotland the Registers of Scotland publish annual medians per 2011 data zone (the latest calendar year, about two years behind the Land Registry file), suppressed under five sales; they come onto the 2022 zones through the postcode crosswalk, and a zone without a price takes its intermediate zone's.

indicators.label: Housing condition
indicators.description: Housing domain of the deprivation index (homes in poor condition or without central heating; in Scotland, overcrowding and no central heating).

indicators.label: House price change
indicators.description: Change in the median sale price, last 12 months against the 12 months before.
indicators.caveats: Noisy where sales are few; in Scotland and Northern Ireland the change is between calendar years, and a Northern Irish ward whose median is suppressed in either year has none.

indicators.label: Council tax (council's Band D rate)
indicators.description: The council's annual charge for a Band D home, including county, police, fire and average parish charges; the like-for-like rate every council publishes.
indicators.caveats: The same for every neighbourhood in a council area; a home's bill depends on its band. Welsh bands are derived from each authority's average band D using the statutory ratios.

indicators.label: Domestic rates (typical home)
indicators.description: Annual domestic rates bill for a home at the area's median capital value, from the regional rate and the council's district rate (Northern Ireland).
indicators.caveats: Northern Ireland charges rates on a home's capital value rather than council tax by band; the bill shown is for a home at the middle of the area's 2016 value mix, so it moves with local values as well as the poundage.

indicators.label: Council tax (typical home here)
indicators.description: What a typical home in the area pays in council tax, each band's charge weighted by how many of the area's homes are in that band.
indicators.caveats: Uses the council's charge per band and the area's band mix, so an area of band A terraces reads about two thirds of the council's Band D rate; discounts and exemptions are not included.

indicators.label: Price to local income
indicators.description: Typical house price divided by the area's mean net household income.
indicators.caveats: Income is a model-based estimate for the wider area (MSOA), for 2022–23.

indicators.label: Homes built since 2000
indicators.description: Share of homes built in 2000 or later.

indicators.label: Homes built before 1919
indicators.description: Share of homes built before 1919.

indicators.label: Homes in council tax bands A–B
indicators.description: Share of homes in the two lowest council tax bands (the cheapest homes in 1991 values).

indicators.label: Income deprivation
indicators.description: Share of residents on low incomes (income domain of the nation's deprivation index).
indicators.caveats: In Wales the rate is WIMD 2025's "people in income deprivation" indicator (StatsWales), the measure behind the domain score.

indicators.label: Employment deprivation
indicators.description: Share of working-age residents involuntarily out of work (employment domain of the nation's deprivation index).
indicators.caveats: In Wales the rate is WIMD 2025's "working age people in employment deprivation" indicator (StatsWales), the measure behind the domain score.

indicators.label: Claimant rate
indicators.description: Residents claiming unemployment-related benefits, as a share of those aged 16–64 (latest month).
indicators.caveats: Not scored because it tracks IoD income deprivation closely (ρ≈0.9), but it is far more recent (monthly). Includes Universal Credit claimants in low-paid work who must look for more.

indicators.label: Household income
indicators.description: Mean net household income in the wider area (MSOA), before housing costs.

indicators.label: Affluence and deprivation (Pobal HP index)
indicators.description: The Pobal HP relative deprivation index of the Electoral Division from Census 2022 (unemployment, education, social class, lone parents, tenure and overcrowding), higher meaning more affluent; a Small Area takes its division's value.
indicators.caveats: Published for Electoral Divisions (about 1,500 people); the Small Area version is licensed. Stands in for the income deprivation share, which Ireland does not publish below county level.

indicators.label: Health and disability
indicators.description: Premature death, illness and disability (health and disability domain of the nation's deprivation index).
indicators.caveats: Built to account for age, unlike self-reported health, which flatters areas of young adults.

indicators.label: Life expectancy
indicators.description: Life expectancy at birth in the wider area (MSOA), the mean of men and women, 2019–23.
indicators.caveats: Shown, not scored, because IoD's health domain (scored) measures much the same at a finer scale.

indicators.label: Good health (self-reported)
indicators.description: Residents describing their health as good or very good (Census 2021; Census 2022 in Scotland).
indicators.caveats: Not adjusted for age, so student areas look healthiest.

indicators.label: Index of multiple deprivation
indicators.description: Overall deprivation score; not scored because its domains overlap other indicators. In Ireland it is Pobal's HP index with its sign flipped, so higher means more deprived there too.

indicators.label: Population density
indicators.description: Residents per square kilometre (Census 2021; Census 2022 in Scotland).

indicators.label: Households with dependent children
indicators.description: Share of households with dependent children (Census 2021; Census 2022 in Scotland).

indicators.label: Residents aged 65 and over
indicators.description: Share of residents aged 65 or over (Census 2021; Census 2022 in Scotland).

indicators.label: Owner-occupied homes
indicators.description: Share of households that own their home outright or with a mortgage (Census 2021; Census 2022 in Scotland).

indicators.label: Households without a car
indicators.description: Share of households with no car or van (Census 2021; Census 2022 in Scotland).

indicators.label: Walk, cycle or public transport to work
indicators.description: Share of workers commuting on foot, by bike or by public transport (Census 2021, during COVID-19 restrictions; Census 2022 in Scotland).

indicators.label: Sunshine
indicators.description: Hours of bright sunshine a year, averaged over 1991–2020 (HadUK-Grid, 1km).
indicators.caveats: A 1km grid interpolated from sunshine recorders, so hills and coasts are smoothed; thirty-year averages say what is usual, not what any year brought.

indicators.label: Wet days
indicators.description: Days a year with at least 1mm of rain, averaged over 1991–2020.
indicators.caveats: Counts days, not amounts, so a drizzly place reads wetter than one with the same rainfall in fewer downpours; rainfall in millimetres is shown beside it.

indicators.label: Summer warmth
indicators.description: Mean daily maximum temperature in June to August, averaged over 1991–2020 (°C).
indicators.caveats: Warmer counts as better here; the days above 25°C are shown beside it for anyone who would rather not have them.

indicators.label: Winter mildness
indicators.description: Mean daily minimum temperature in December to February, averaged over 1991–2020 (°C).
indicators.caveats: Night-time lows, which drive frost and heating bills; coasts and cities read milder than the hills behind them.

indicators.label: Annual rainfall
indicators.description: Average rainfall a year, 1991–2020, from Met Éireann's 1 km grid; stands in for wet days, which Met Éireann publishes no grid of.
indicators.caveats: Total rainfall, not how often it rains; the thresholds follow the UK wet-day ones (120 and 200 days correspond to about 800 and 1,600 mm across the UK grid).

indicators.label: Rainfall
indicators.description: Rainfall a year in millimetres, averaged over 1991–2020.

indicators.label: Days of air frost
indicators.description: Days a year when the air temperature falls below 0°C, averaged over 1991–2020.

indicators.label: Summer days
indicators.description: Days a year when the temperature reaches 25°C, averaged over 1991–2020.

indicators.label: Wind
indicators.description: Mean wind speed at 10m, averaged over 1991–2020.

indicators.label: Days with snow lying
indicators.description: Days a year with snow on the ground at 9am, averaged over 1991–2020.

indicators.label: Hot summer days in a 2°C world
indicators.description: Days a year with a maximum above 30°C once the world has warmed by 2°C, from the Met Office's UKCP18 local projections for the area's neighbourhood.
indicators.caveats: A projection for the MSOA, Intermediate Zone or district electoral area, copied to every small area inside (an estimate for the neighbourhood, not the small area); a hot summer day is one above 30°C in any month, the median of sixteen UKCP18 model runs, so much of the north reads 0 at 2°C and the count says how often such days would come, not how hot the place is.

safety.label: Safety
safety.description: Recorded crime and anti-social behaviour where people live.

environment.label: Environment
environment.description: Clean air, quiet streets, trees and green space nearby, and flood risk.

health.label: Health services
health.description: How easily residents can see a GP, pharmacist or dentist.

education.label: Schools & childcare
education.description: Good schools and nurseries within reach.

transport.label: Transport & connectivity
transport.description: How well an area connects to jobs and services by every mode, and its broadband.

amenities.label: Amenities & nightlife
amenities.description: Shops, cafés, well-run pubs, leisure and culture nearby.

housing.label: Housing & affordability
housing.description: What homes cost and the condition of the housing stock.

community.label: Community & wellbeing
community.description: Income, work and health of the people who live there.

climate.label: Climate
climate.description: Sunshine, rain and how warm the summers and mild the winters are, from thirty-year averages.

family.label: Family with children
family.description: Good schools and nurseries, safety and green space come first.

young_professional.label: Young professional
young_professional.description: Connections, things to do and well-run pubs; schools matter less.

retiree.label: Retired
retiree.description: Safety, health services, clean air, sunshine and a quieter area.

commuter.label: Commuter
commuter.description: Fast connections to jobs, by public transport above all.
